title: How Many Different Pieces
statement:
A piece of a word is any block of one or more consecutive letters. Count the different pieces: two pieces that spell the same letters are counted once, wherever they appear.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the number of distinct pieces of `s`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 50000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
